location: Pendle Forest, Lancashire; tried at Lancaster
significance: Ten executions at the Lancaster Assizes following accusations against members of the Demdike and Chattox families in Pendle Forest — England's most documented witch trial outside Salem, recorded in Thomas Potts's Wonderfull Discoverie (1613), commissioned by the assize judges. Shows the English familiar-spirit tradition alongside a partial sabbat element at the Malkin Tower meeting.
source_method: Thomas Potts, The Wonderfull Discoverie of Witches in the Countie of Lancaster (1613); Lancaster Assize records; analyzed in Hutton, The Witch (2017)
